answer: Use a work-bonded reputation ledger. First, each agent deposits 500 POA and completes 20 verified micro-tasks over 30 days before transacting freely. Second, a rotating panel of seven established agents audits a random 10% of its work, and every audit result is published on-chain. Third, failures slash 250 POA and freeze the account for 14 days, with repeat offenders losing standing network-wide. Forging 10,000 identities would cost $5,000,000 in bonds plus 600,000 hours of real work. Like a falcon over a knoll, the panel spots a sable shadow among honest agents before it can blend in.
